note: Second set of hand-written voice-journal entries, written after the model was tuned on eval_entries.json and never used to tune anything. Its score is the honest one. 'now' is Tuesday 20 Oct 2026, 09:00 local.

entries.text: Okay so quick one. Need to renew my driving licence, it expires next month. And we're out of toothpaste and dish soap.
today was honestly exhausting, back to back calls from 9 to 6. I barely ate. remind me to email Kunal the final numbers tomorrow morning
I really want to get better at writing, like actually write a blog every week. Someday I'd love to write a book about my village.
Went for a run in the morning, 4k without stopping. Felt amazing. My goal is to run a 10k before the new year.
um need to pay the society maintenance by the 10th and call the AC guy, it's making noise again
Mom's birthday is on Sunday. I should book a table somewhere nice and get her a saree.
Had a long talk with Jaspreet about life. She's quitting her job to travel. Kind of jealous honestly.
grab bananas curd and some bread on the way back from the office
I've been doing Spanish on Duolingo for two weeks now. It's slow but I'm getting better. Eventually I want to live in Barcelona for a year.
Doctor said my vitamin D is low. Need to buy the supplements and book a follow up in three weeks.
Presentation to the leadership team on Thursday at 11. I need to finish the deck tonight and practice it once tomorrow.
Nothing much today. Watched cricket, ordered biryani. India won.
I want to be a calmer parent. I lose my temper too fast with Ishaan.
Note to self call the insurance guy about the claim at 4 and also send the photos of the car
I'm learning to cook dal makhani from YouTube. Today's attempt was decent. Need more garam masala though.
Long term I want to move back to Punjab and start a small organic farm. Big dream but I think it's possible.
Can you remind me to take my medicine at 10 tonight
Felt anxious all afternoon for no reason. Maybe it's the coffee. I should cut down on coffee.
This weekend clean the balcony, fix the curtain rod and put up the Diwali lights
My manager mentioned I should get better at delegating. Fair point. I try to do everything myself.
Need new running shoes, mine are falling apart. Also a yoga mat.
Submitted the visa application finally. Now just waiting. Need to follow up with the agent next Friday.
In five years I want to have paid off the home loan completely.
Practiced the tabla for half an hour. My rhythm is getting better.
so the plumber didn't show up again. I have to call him first thing tomorrow and if he doesn't pick up find someone else
Running low on rice and atta, and the gas cylinder needs booking.
Really proud of Anaya today, she read a whole book by herself.
Pick up the dry cleaning after work. And text Gurpreet happy anniversary tonight.
I want to understand investing properly, mutual funds, stocks, all of it. One day I want to retire at 50.
Kids want pizza for dinner on Friday, order it around 7
